source: Google Sheet 'Calvin and Krish - Spotify tracks', read 2026-11-06. Titles, artists, years and lengths from each link's public Spotify page. Answers added 2026-11-06: the JAIV 'waaaow' timestamps and the Hypnotised radio seed (Krish).

references.title: No Limoncello
references.notes: Reference to copy the arrangement of as a jumping-off point: vocal chops, bassline, percussion, keys/synth. Krish: love this.

references.title: On The Ground
references.notes: Krish: the growly bass. Calvin: call and response melody, call is three bars, answer in the fourth; chopped vocals.

references.title: Sorry I Am Late (Extended)
references.notes: Krish: oldie but what a tune. Calvin: big tune.

references.title: Lose My Cool (Franc Moody Remix)
references.notes: Krish: nice percussive bass. Calvin: going deep on Franc Moody; Amber Mark is great too.

references.title: Flashing Lights
references.notes: Calvin: our track reminds him of old Kanye. Ideas: synthy chord moments to give the listener a break from the piano; tease the guitar for 8 bars before the solo.

references.title: Hypnotised Radio (Spotify radio playlist)
references.artist: with Franc Moody, Miami Horror, NEIL FRANCES and more
references.notes: Krish: one of the better Spotify radios, because it comes from a banger; fresh air after his usual playlist. Calvin: will listen. Seed track (Krish): Franc Moody, 'Hypnotised'.

references.title: Lanarka
references.notes: Krish: always sounds great on good headphones; panning and crisp beats.

references.title: Omeo
references.notes: Calvin: inspo for Friday. Krish: lots of nice panning.

references.title: Childhood Dreams
references.notes: Krish: 'Waaaaaooooow sound': the noise that comes in at 0:24, 0:31, 0:55, 1:03 and on through the track. Krish: 'a deep electronic growly noise'.

references.title: 5th & Concord (Original Mix)
references.notes: Shared with Vernal. Krish: these are the electronic sounds he wants to find. Calvin: very organic sound; loves the chords in this track and in Vernal, lots of melodic percussion; organic packs on Splice to explore.

references.title: The Bridge (Original Mix)
references.notes: Calvin: a snare with a texture layered on top; call and response between it and the rim shot. He added a call-and-response rhythm to their track the night before.

references.title: Archangel
references.notes: Krish: this is nice; blast it, headphones or otherwise.
